title: Side-by-side play that sometimes becomes shared is a 30-month item
summary: CDC says most children, by about 30 months, play next to other children and at times play with them.
body: The 30-month social milestones say the child plays next to other children and sometimes plays with them. One sentence holds both the side-by-side scene and the occasional joint scene. CDC's most means 75 percent or more. Earlier tips for 2-year-olds had warned that sharing is still hard; this line is the later checklist, not that warning. The sheet is not a screening test. A textbook row that says age 2 plays alongside others is a different document.

sources.title: Learn the Signs. Act Early. milestone page
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports the 30-month social milestone 'Plays next to other children and sometimes plays with them.' US federal page, public domain. Paraphrased, not quoted.
